== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Reader's burn is a physical condition that affects individuals known as [[Readers]] when they exceed their personal capabilities. The ailment can manifest as a severe, persistent headache that feels like being struck in the head with bricks. In more extreme instances, it can cause significant visual impairment, such as being unable to see clearly for a week, or intense physical pain comparable to a red-hot brand against the skin. Depending on its severity, the effects of the burn may last for several months.}}
